function.name: vulkan_init
function.description: This function initializes the Vulkan handle. It ensures the initialization only happens once using the pthread_once function.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not accept any parameters

function.return_type: BOOL, returns a boolean value indicating the status of the Vulkan handle

function.name: __wine_get_vulkan_driver
function.description: This function checks if the provided version matches the WINE_VULKAN_DRIVER_VERSION. If it does, it initializes the Vulkan and returns a pointer to vulkan_funcs. If not, it logs an error and returns NULL.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: This parameter represents the version of the Vulkan driver.

function.return_type: struct vulkan_funcs, represents the Vulkan functions if the version matches and Vulkan is initialized successfully, otherwise NULL.
